summary: Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report) attaching a press release and TR-1 notification disclosing that BlackRock, Inc. crossed an AIM notification threshold on September 23, 2026. BlackRock's holding slipped to 5.03% of voting rights from 5.09%, with financial instruments (0.83% securities lending, 1.09% cash-settled CFDs) trimming the combined position to 6.96% from 7.04%, a routine passive-flow change. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural event are stated; watch ordinary index-flow volatility, not risk-arb.
